verdict.rationale: Simular (Sai) is a software computer-use agent that runs on cloud computers or a user's own Mac/Windows device. Shipping hardware rigs with a bill of materials, wiring and flashing steps is outside this product category. Its BYOD support only means it installs on existing computers, not that it provides physical hardware or build guides.

support.subject: As a power user, hardware rigs come with a bill of materials, wiring, and flashing steps I can follow end to end
